source_instruction: i am looking for anti aging cream with green tea and hyaluronic acid. i want it to be effective for dark circles
query: Ugh, I stopped by the bakery on the way over here and they were completely out of my favorite matcha croissants, the ones with the little white chocolate drizzle on top that I get every Saturday after my yoga class. My yoga instructor kept raving about how adding honey to your post-workout smoothie does wonders for your energy levels, too, and I swear I saw a sparrow building a nest in the hanging fern right outside the store entrance when I walked in. I’ve heard that eye care products formulated with green tea and hyaluronic acid work really well for targeting signs of anti aging and reducing the appearance of dark circles, and that nice options under $50 are totally easy to come by in this section.
